Subject: Claim Decision Regarding {CLAIM_NUMBER}

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed our review of your collision claim. At this time, we are denying your request for coverage.

Our decision is based on the results of our investigation. The photos provided show a different vehicle than the one listed on your policy; therefore, the damage could not be verified. Your policy includes the following coverage: "[COLL-1] We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
